title: Dragon Ball
creator: Akira Toriyama
relation: Source manga for Dragon Ball, Dragon Ball Z and Kai. Related franchise manga for the anime-original Daima.
description: Bulma recruits a boy with a monkey tail to find seven wish-granting Dragon Balls.

title: Dragon Ball Super
creator: Akira Toriyama and Toyotarou
relation: Parallel manga continuity for Super and its Beerus story. Later Super Hero chapters adapt the film.
description: Beerus comes to Earth searching for a Super Saiyan God. The later Super Hero arc follows Piccolo and Gohan against the revived Red Ribbon Army.

creator: Tsugumi Ohba and Takeshi Obata
